actions.action: Squeeze the cut end and brown nubs to check firmness
If soft or mushy, cut back to firm tissue with an alcohol-wiped razor and air-dry 2-4 hours
Remove the sphagnum, rinse the jug and refill with plain room-temperature water covering the node
Move the cutting to bright indirect light at 68-80°F away from drafts

reason: The answer rightly calls the slow rooting normal and removes the moss, but it never flags the frequent water changes as a cause and tells the poster to keep doing them, so it gets only half of the fix; the advice is not seriously harmful.
